summary: Australian Oilseeds Holdings filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting held November 10, 2026 (record date October 21, 2026), conducted virtually via Zoom. Shareholders approved an 80-for-one share consolidation across class A, class B and preference shares, a related share capital reduction and reorganization under Cayman Islands solvency provisions, an authorized share capital increase, and amended articles. No acquisition, divestiture, tender or activist event is involved. The mechanics are capital-structure housekeeping, not a special situation; watch Nasdaq effectiveness timing and post-consolidation liquidity.
